caption:
Garlic Tadka Khichdi - No cutting required! 
I keep minced garlic in bulk in the fridge so no vegetables were harmed in the making of this video 😅

Ingredients: 
1/2 cup rice + 1/2 cup dal (toor or moong), rinsed till water runs clear and soak for 30 minutes 
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp haldi
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp coriander powder
pinch of hing
salt, to taste
around 500 - 600 ml water

For the tadka: 
Ghee (replace with oil to make this vegan) + jeera + mustard seeds + hing + red chilli powder + minced garlic 

-Chopped coriander 

Method: 
-place all your ingredients in a pressure cooker and allow to cook for 3 whistles
-once the pressure is released from the cooker, make your tadka
-add all your tadka ingredients to a pan as shown in the video! 
-add to your khichadi and stir adding in your fresh coriander at the end
